name: Bank Fixed Deposit
description: Locked-in deposit with a bank at a fixed interest rate, principal protected and insured up to a limit.

name: Public Provident Fund (PPF)
description: Government-backed 15-year savings scheme with tax-free interest and maturity amount.

name: Short-Duration Debt Mutual Fund
description: Pooled fund investing in short-term bonds and money market instruments, more liquid than an FD.
risks: Small credit risk on underlying bonds

name: AAA-Rated Corporate Bonds
description: Direct lending to high-credit-rating companies in exchange for fixed periodic interest.

name: Nifty 50 Index Fund
description: Passively tracks the Nifty 50 index — broad exposure to India's largest companies at low cost.
risks: No downside protection in a crash

name: Hybrid (Equity + Debt) Mutual Fund
description: Blends equity and debt in one fund to smooth out volatility while still capturing growth.

name: Gold ETF / Sovereign Gold Bonds
description: Exposure to gold prices without physical storage; Sovereign Gold Bonds also pay small fixed interest.
risks: SGBs have an 8-year lock-in for full tax benefit

name: REITs (Real Estate Investment Trusts)
description: Own a slice of rent-yielding commercial real estate on the stock exchange without buying property directly.

name: Small-Cap Equity Mutual Fund
description: Invests in smaller, high-growth-potential companies with higher volatility than large-caps.

name: Sectoral / Thematic Fund (e.g. Defence, EV, AI)
description: Concentrated bets on a specific high-growth theme or sector rather than the broad market.

name: P2P Lending Platforms
description: Lend directly to vetted borrowers through an RBI-registered NBFC-P2P platform for higher yields than debt funds.

name: Alternative Investment Fund (AIF Cat II/III)
description: Pooled fund for private equity, structured credit, or hedge-fund-style strategies — SEBI regulated but for high-net-worth entry points.

name: Startup Equity / Angel Investing
description: Direct equity in early-stage private companies via angel networks or syndicates — high risk, high potential upside.
risks: Highly illiquid, no exit for years

name: International Equity Fund (US/Global)
description: Diversify beyond India into global markets like the US, reducing single-country concentration.

name: Crypto (BTC/ETH, small allocation)
description: Highly volatile digital assets — should only ever be a small, 'can-afford-to-lose' slice of a portfolio.

name: Liquid Mutual Fund
description: Very short-term debt fund, ideal for parking money you might need on short notice, better than a savings account.
risks: Slightly lower returns than longer-duration debt funds
